content:
Sprinklr is an enterprise-grade Software-as-a-Service platform. It primarily supports unified customer experience management. The platform is especially made for large-scale companies. In turn, Sprinklr helps brands to manage social media, customer service, marketing insights, and digital engagement. All of this is done through a single connected platform. 

At its core, Sprinklr Social is a powerful enterprise social media management solution. This is possible in more than 30 digital channels.

How does Sprinklr work?

It works in four key stages:

  • Data Collection and Listening- Sprinklr connects with owned, earned and paid digital channels. 
  • AI-powered analysis- Its AI engine understands conversions, finds customer intent, and detects sentiment. In turn, it automatically categorises interactions.
  • Workflows Automation and Governance- The platform moves content, customer interactions, and approvals through predefined workflows. This is done with role-based permissions and compliance controls. 
  • Action and Reporting - Sprinklr helps teams publish content, reply to customers, start campaigns, and measure results.

Core Capabilities

Enterprise Publishing and Campaign Management

Sprinklr helps global organisations to plan, manage, and execute social media campaigns. This is done across multiple channels while maintaining governance and consistency.

Unified Customer Engagement

It gives a centralised Smart Inbox. Through this, customer care teams can manage messages, comments, reviews and conversations from multiple channels.

Social listening and Consumer Intelligence

The platform monitors public conversations, industry trends, competitor activity and brand sentiment in online communities.

What makes Sprinklr different?

  • Unified Customer Experience Platform- Sprinklr works on marketing, customer service, social engagement and insights at once. 
  • Massive Omnichannel Coverage - It supports more than 30 social, messaging, review, and digital communication channels.
  • Enterprise-Grade Governance- The platform gives advanced permissions, compliance workflows, audit logs and approval structures. 
  • AI-driven automation- Sprinklr uses proprietary AI technologies to automate customer care, content moderation, sentiment analysis, and operational workflows.

Key Services

  • Sprinklr Social- Sprinklr's flagship social media management solution, Sprinklr Social, is focused on publishing, engagement, governance and listening.
  • Sprinklr Service- It is an AI-powered customer service and digital contact centre platform. In turn, it manages customer conversations on social, messaging and digital channels. 
  • Sprinklr Insights- The platform's special consumer intelligence platform works on sentiment analysis, competitor monitoring, trend detection and market research. 
  • Sprinklr Marketing- Sprinklr is a collaborative marketing operations platform. It helps companies to manage campaigns, budgets, assets, approvals and content planning.

Advanced Capabilities

  1. Proprietary Enterprise AI- Sprinklr uses special AI models to automate customer service, content creation, intent recognition, sentiment analysis and executive reporting. 
  2. Predictive Sentiment Analysis- It monitors the shifts in public perception. The platform also finds emerging trends before they become major issues. 
  3. Visual Listening and Computer Vision- The platform understands images and videos to find logos, products, brand mentions and contextual use. This is possible even when the brands are not directly tagged.
  4. Automated Crisis Detection- Sprinklr finds unusual increases in negative sentiment, customer complaints, or high-risk conversions. In turn, it immediately alerts teams.

Who should use Backstory?

  • Global Enterprise who work in multiple countries, languages, and regions. 
  • High-Volume Consumer Brands that get thousands of daily customer interactions on social media, messaging apps and review platforms.
  • Regulated Industries who work in sectors with strict legal compliance. 
  • Enterprise Customer Service Teams looking to modernise digital customer care operations using AI-powered automation.

Best-Fit Industries

  • Banking and Financial Services
  • Retail 
  • Healthcare 
  • Travel and Hospitality 
  • Telecommunications 

Key Use Cases

  • Digital Customer Care Transformation- Sprinklr helps companies to replace divided customer support channels with a unified digital contact centre. It is done using AI and automation. 
  • Crisis Management and Brand Protection - It enables PR and Communication teams to track conversations, identify emerging threats, and respond to crises before they escalate. 
  • Global Content Governance- The platform helps marketing teams to maintain brand consistency in multiple regions. It does so using a single content management system and approval workflows. 
  • Consumer Intelligence and Market Research - Sprinklr helps companies understand customer conversations and demo activity to make strategic business decisions.

Pros 

  • Supports more than 30 digital channels 
  • Comprehensive Unified-CXM platform
  • Powerful AI-driven customer care automation 
  • Real-time crisis monitoring and response tools

Considerations

  • Premium pricing 
  • Steep learning curve for new user
  • Full deployment may take several months

Top Alternatives

  • MarketJoy- Specializes in multi-channel B2B lead generation services
  • Sprout Social- It is a user-friendly enterprise social media platform. It specialises in providing publishing and customer care services. 
  • Hootsuite Enterprise- The platform gives enterprise-focused social media management tools.
  • Emplifi- It is a customer experience platform mainly for social media management, customer care and commerce solutions.
  • Khoros- It is an expert in enterprise social engagement, customer communities, and digital customer service.

Conclusion

Sprinklr is one of the most powerful enterprise customer experience and social media management platforms in the market. It can unify social engagement, customer care, marketing operations, governance analysis, and consumer intelligence into a single platform. 

Are you an enterprise managing large-scale customer engagement on multiple channels? Sprinklr is the ideal tool that gives depth, scalability, and unified customer experience.
